implementationLimits: No raw WGU model, source mapping, provider recommendation or student credit record is changed by this review artifact.
Five capstone designations are explicitly supported by current official course titles or descriptions, independent of subject-area labels.

Accounting and IT Management remain held for exact capstone applicability and institutional residency floor; their current complete ledgers and overall transfer ceilings are independently established.
Upper-level policy resolution means the full current named curriculum is enforced. It never invents a zero upper-level minimum.
The required active-program credit accounting must accompany any integrated residency rule; prior WGU credit is not automatically current-program residency.
